title: Cancel Aarav Patel’s Amazon Interview Booking

ticketDescription: Cancel Aarav Patel’s 10:00 AM Amazon Interview booking on 2024-11-25. Preserve their other interview rounds and other students' scheduled sessions.
targetCriteriaDescription: Registration #204 (Aarav Patel, Amazon Interview, 2024-11-25 10:00) status must transition to "cancelled". Every other interview booking must remain untouched.

exercises.lessonExplanation: The query filtered WHERE student_id = 'STU-404'. In an interview scheduling system, a candidate can participate in multiple concurrent company rounds. Updating by student_id unconditionally cancels all of the candidate's interviews. Use registration_id = 204 to isolate the cancellation.
